# Aperture masks and local adjustments

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/masks`

## Summary

Limit any adjustment layer to part of the photo with a mask built from components: linear gradient, radial, brush, luminosity range, colour range and AI subject selection.

## Details

### Component `gradient` (Linear gradient)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `from`: object
  - `x`: -1 to 2, default 0
  - `y`: -1 to 2, default 0
- `to`: object
  - `x`: -1 to 2, default 0
  - `y`: -1 to 2, default 0
- `feather`: 0 to 1, default 0
### Component `radial` (Radial)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `center`: object
  - `x`: -1 to 2, default 0
  - `y`: -1 to 2, default 0
- `rx`: 0 to 2, default 0.3
- `ry`: 0 to 2, default 0.3
- `rotate`: -180 to 180, default 0
- `feather`: 0 to 1, default 0.5
### Component `brush` (Brush)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `width`: integer 1 to 1024
- `height`: integer 1 to 1024
### Component `luminosity` (Luminosity range)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `lo`: 0 to 1, default 0
- `hi`: 0 to 1, default 1
- `feather`: 0 to 1, default 0.1
### Component `colorRange` (Color range)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `colors`: list (up to 16)
  - `r`: integer 0 to 255, default 0
  - `g`: integer 0 to 255, default 0
  - `b`: integer 0 to 255, default 0
- `fuzziness`: 0 to 100, default 40
### Component `subject` (Select subject)
- `kind`
- `mode`: one of add, subtract, intersect, default "add"
- `invert`: true/false, default false
### The mask
- `feather`: 0 to 100, default 0
- `invert`: true/false, default false
- `opacity`: 0 to 1, default 1
Components combine with add, subtract or intersect. Coordinates are fractions of the image (0–1). Brush masks are painted by the user; AI subject selection costs one everyday job and is offered as a button.
Darken a bright sky: an exposure layer (ev about -0.7) masked with a linear gradient from the top. Spotlight a subject: a radial mask, inverted, on an exposure layer with ev -0.5.
